description: PGN Studio supplemental golden fixtures proving the platform regex engine behind pgn-extract's =~ tag-criteria operator (taglines.c/lists.c) and the fixed odds-game pattern (grammar.c check_for_odds) are actually wired in and functioning - the upstream test/ suite has NO =~ coverage at all (verified: `grep '=~' test/` finds nothing). On Windows this proves TRE v0.9.0 is live, not just linked. Consumed by scripts/verify-engine.ps1's supplemental-goldens layer.
criteriaFileEncoding: UTF-8, no BOM, LF line endings - a BOM makes pgn-extract silently ignore every criterion in the file (verified during Phase 0b).

cases.name: literal
cases.description: Unanchored literal substring match via =~ (BRE with no metacharacters). 'Capa' matches anywhere in the White value.

cases.name: anchors
cases.description: ^...$ anchors constrain =~ to a full-string match. 'Tal' matches exactly; 'Taljunior' must NOT match even though it starts with 'Tal', distinguishing anchored from unanchored matching.

cases.name: bracket
cases.description: Bracket expression [BS] in =~ selects multiple games (Black starting with B or S), excluding a third that starts with neither.

cases.name: star
cases.description: Kleene star (zero-or-more) in =~: ^AB*C$ matches 'AC' (zero B) and 'ABC' (one B), not 'AXC'.

cases.name: backref
cases.description: Escaped group \( \) with backreference \1 in =~: ^\(.\).*\1$ matches only when the Event value's first and last characters are identical ('abcba'), not when they differ ('abcde'). Deliberately avoids GNU BRE alternation (\|), which the design explicitly flags as a portability risk across POSIX BRE engines (TRE vs glibc vs BSD libc) - backreferences are core POSIX BRE (IEEE Std 1003.1-2001), which TRE targets.

cases.name: odds
cases.description: The OTHER regex call site (grammar.c check_for_odds, not taglines.c/lists.c): a fixed internal pattern ^[^/]*/[^/]*/8/8/8/8/ tested against the FEN tag under --odds. A queen-odds starting position (empty ranks 6-3) matches; a lone-kings mid-board endgame position (king on rank 6) does not. No criteria file - --odds is a plain flag.
